foodScreening.method: 逐店阅读具体作者、日期和样本，筛除地址错配、集中宣传、重复记录、明显质量争议与地方特色不足者；不声称独立验证评论或真实消费。

ticketPolicy: Published basic prices retain source dates and exact scope. Fanjing entrance/season choices and FAST visit combinations require a user choice. FAST free platform access excludes mandatory transport; bundled transport must not be counted twice. Historical Huangguoshu prices remain pending rather than silently prefilled.
